title: Learning and Comparing Local Traces for Weakly Supervised Image Manipulation Localization
abstract: arXiv:2601.06222v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Image manipulation localization identifies edited regions and provides spatial evidence for assessing image reliability, but fully supervised methods require costly pixel-level annotations. Weakly supervised methods reduce this cost using image-level labels, but classification can rely on a few salient cues without ensuring accurate or complete localization. This difficulty is pronounced when manipulation traces are weak and unevenly distributed and authentic and manipulated regions share similar appearance. We propose a CLIP-based framework that integrates Trace-Oriented Vision--Language Adaptation (TOVA) and Relation-Aware Trace Discrimination (RATD). TOVA adapts the visual encoder and uses global visual context to aggregate edge-weighted patch features into image-conditioned class prompts. The resulting class representations support image-level alignment and guide patch selection for Hierarchical Trace Contrastive Learning,

translated_title: 学习与比较局部痕迹的弱监督图像篡改定位方法
translated_abstract: 图像篡改定位旨在识别图像中被编辑的区域，并为评估图像可靠性提供空间证据，但全监督方法需要代价高昂的像素级标注。弱监督方法通过使用图像级标签降低了这一成本，但分类可能仅依赖少量显著线索，而无法保证定位的准确性和完整性。当篡改痕迹微弱且分布不均匀、真实区域与篡改区域外观相似时，这一难题尤为突出。我们提出了一种基于CLIP的框架，融合了面向痕迹的视觉—语言自适应（TOVA）和关系感知痕迹判别（RATD）两个模块。TOVA对视觉编码器进行自适应调整，并利用全局视觉上下文将边缘加权的图像块特征聚合为以图像为条件的类别提示。由此得到的类别表示支持图像级对齐，并指导层次化痕迹对比学习中的图像块选择。
tldr: 提出一种基于CLIP的弱监督图像篡改定位框架，通过面向痕迹的视觉—语言自适应（TOVA）与关系感知痕迹判别（RATD）来学习和比较局部篡改痕迹，在无需像素级标注的情况下实现更准确完整的篡改区域定位。
